desc: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED. Offline ticket 122 is done and independent exact-artifact review PASSed. One storage-disabled maxcpus=2 boot appends exactly 'maxcpus=2 earlycon=dockchannel,mmio32,0x50882c000 keep_bootcon initcall_blacklist=apple_dctty_init' and uses a reproducible kmsg-only reporter. The early writer performs one proven TX_FREE 0x14 read per byte, drops immediately when full, and otherwise writes TX8 0x04; it has no wait/RX/config/IRQ/new offset. No cpufreq, USB/storage, PCIe, SPMI, or other new MMIO. Requires fresh maintainer approval because this ticket postdates the last approve-all, plus healthy rig, lease, and bounded stop/recovery. Never retry ticket 005 unchanged.

progress: 2026-07-29 REVIEWED GO + READY (claude, done/2026-07-29-t6040-123-maxcpus2-review.md). All ten pinned hashes resolve on disk and match. Patch verified single-file: one TX_FREE(0x14) read per byte, immediate drop when full, one TX8(0x04) write, no RX/IRQ/mask/config/new-offset, EARLYCON_DECLARE only, bails if membase unset; earlycon addr 0x50882c000 is the ticket-062 DATA window (correct, ADT-derived); initcall_blacklist=apple_dctty_init prevents a second FIFO owner. DT isolation verified not assumed: 15 cpu@ nodes with cpu@10105 status=disabled (14 usable), ZERO pcie@ nodes, nvme disabled, all three usb@ disabled, 7/8 iommu@ disabled. Reporter bounded/read-only: cpu_possible/present/online, processor count, taskset -c 1 (so a second core must actually execute), PASS/FAIL marker, 40-line dmesg grep, then sleeps; no reboot/retry.
